entities.name: NAD(P)H-hydrate repair Nnr
observations: 494-aa query matches reviewed Nnr homologs across nearly the full sequence (98.6–99.4% coverage; 40.4–51.1% identity), supporting a bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme assignment.
Homolog annotations assign NAD(P)HX epimerization (EC 5.1.99.6) and ADP-dependent dehydration of the S epimer (EC 4.2.1.136).
Reviewed reference annotations report one bound K+ per subunit; this sequence's potassium requirement is inferred by homology, not directly tested.

entities.name: NADHX dehydration
observations: Homolog-catalogued reaction: (6S)-NADHX + ADP = NADH + AMP + phosphate + H+ (Rhea:32223).
Homolog-catalogued counterpart: (6S)-NADPHX + ADP = NADPH + AMP + phosphate + H+ (Rhea:32235).
